verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developers.circle.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a dedicated 'Agent Instructions' section. The docs homepage points agents to the /llms.txt index, and pages are served as markdown (.md). The llms.txt also lists installable agent skills (Claude Code plugin, Vercel Skills CLI) covering USDC, wallets and Arc. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively in practice.
